name: The Battle - Kylie Minogue Vs. Jessie Ware Vs. Robyn
description: This event is a drag show that pays tribute to Kylie Minogue, Jessie Ware, and Robyn, featuring their iconic hits. It includes an electrifying DJ set and drag performances.
longDescription:
The Battle - Kylie Minogue Vs. Jessie Ware Vs. Robyn is a drag show celebrating three legendary artists. The event features an electrifying DJ set and drag performances, bringing disco vibes to the dance floor.

The show takes place at Bar of Soap - Porto, located at Rua do Bolhão 132, 4000-111 Porto, Portugal. It is scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026, from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

Tickets are available starting at €6.00 for early birds, with general admission tickets priced at €7.00. Attendees can resell their tickets on Shotgun if needed.
